submittedParameters.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept, a SINGLE standalone game UI vehicle sprite. Create one small rounded Chinese Taoist chibi transport HELICOPTER, matching the attached two style reference images: elegant jade green and warm ivory body, delicate brass gold trim, fine hand-painted texture and soft rounded volumes, NO plastic sheen or photorealism. A civilian passenger/cargo utility helicopter with unmistakable large horizontal TOP ROTOR and smaller TAIL ROTOR, landing skids, glazed cream-green cabin, side passenger door. Front-left 3/4 view angled to the right, whole helicopter including both rotor tips and tail fully visible with ample transparent padding all around. No wings of an aeroplane, no people, no weapons. Genuine transparent alpha background, no checkerboard, no shadows on a ground plane, no label, text, numbers or frame. One complete isolated helicopter only. Square canvas high native detail desired 1024x1024. This will be displayed as a 150px game thumbnail; clear distinct silhouette.
